name: scenario_remainder_split
derivation: Pins exact integer phasing with a remainder, plus the IRR window policy.
Revenue 1,000,001 agorot phased over periods 1-3: floor(1,000,001/3) = 333,333 each,
remainder 2 distributed one agora to the two EARLIEST periods of the window
One planning cost of 2 agorot at period 0. Expected cashflows:
Simple payback: cumulative -2 then +333,332; recovery inside period 1:
2/333,334 = 0.000005999988000024 (expansion of exact fraction; asserted to 12 sig figs).
IRR: cashflows do change sign, but NPV stays positive across the whole policy window:
NPV -> +inf as r -> -0.99. The true root (~166,666 per period) lies far outside
(-0.99, 10), so by the documented window policy irr = null.
